**On-call handoff — gateway 503s, 2026-03-14**

Root cause: `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation," shipped 02:12–02:14Z) broke connection pool release. Pool stuck at size 20 / in_use 20 right after, with the waiting queue climbing non-stop instead of draining — a leak, not load.

Impact window: 02:14:18Z to at least 03:59:27Z (last line in the log), still failing when the log ends. Gateway only — `worker.log` shows no errors or pool issues in this window, just one unrelated known slow-query warning at 02:36Z (OPS-2210).

Roll back: `dep-4471` on gateway.
